title: Shinonome Ena — Enjoyable Afternoon, Uncertain Future〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Argh! No, it still looks all wrong...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So much for finishing my rough sketch today...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's been two days since Mafuyu started staying over at Kanade's house...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is she really gonna be okay...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heya! How are things going on your end?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Don't just yell all of a sudden!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Fortunately, it sounded like K was the one talking to Yuki's mom, so we have nothing to worry about there...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<But we shouldn't let our guard down.
Who knows what that woman's gonna do next?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, has K told you the rest of that story yet?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Apparently Yuki's mom went over to K's house yesterday.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, but she made sure to call K in advance, though!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<She did?!
Geez... So, how'd that go...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yuki apparently repeated over and over that she didn't want to go home.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Which is why she's staying over at K's place now.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mafuyu actually told her mom that she didn't want to go home.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, Yuki...! You feeling a little better now?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Seems like a lot has happened recently. Are you holding up okay?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Working seems to help take her mind off of things. I know it's a little early, but I had her start already.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Right!
Now that she's at your house, K, that means she can actually join us at 25:00!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, wait a second. Do you have any other clothes to change into, Yuki?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <She's wearing some of my sweats for now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<She is?
But you and Yuki aren't really the same size...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, they're probably a little tight on her...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <It's okay. They are a little small, but they'll do.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That reminds me of how you complained about my pajamas being too small when you stayed over at my house.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, settle down. Don't go biting her head off♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Still, aren't you gonna need a lot of stuff if you plan on staying for an extended period?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, since you can't really share toothbrushes or underwear and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Enanan's right. We should try getting what you need.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, if it's about money, don't worry. I can chip in a little.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Then, why not just call it a gift...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It'd be a lot easier to accept as opposed to receiving cash straight up, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, nice idea!
We've got tons of spare toothbrushes at my house!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <And I'm pretty sure we have a lot of extra pajamas stashed away somewhere.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Little stuff like that should help hold you over for at least a little while, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Alright, I'll try looking for anything you can use.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'll also try looking for some stuff that I can give you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <We can bring them over the next time we gather at the diner.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<It's the least we can do.
For now, just try to get your life and feelings back in order, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness for Kanade...
Mafuyu doesn't seem to be feeling as down as when she came over to my house.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (It doesn't have to be immediate, but I hope she starts feeling better soon.)
